props.gloss_en: R' Yaakov breih deVat Yaakov: anyone on whose account his fellow is punished is not brought into the partition of the Holy One, blessed be He
R' Yochanan: 'the spirit' (I Kgs 22:21) is the spirit of Navot
Rav: 'go out' (I Kgs 22:22) means: go out of My partition
'you are sated with shame instead of honour' (Hab 2:16) -- this is Nebuchadnezzar
'drink also you, and be uncircumcised' (Hab 2:16) -- this is Zedekiah
'to punish is also not good for the righteous' (Prov 17:26) -- and 'not good' is nothing but evil
'for You are not a God who desires wickedness; evil shall not dwell with You' (Ps 5:5) -- You are righteous, Lord, and evil shall not dwell in Your dwelling
the mishna's word חלשים is a term for lots

Rabba bar Rav Huna: 'how you have fallen from heaven... cholesh over the nations' (Is 14:12) teaches that he would cast lots over the royal nobles to know whose day it was [for him] for mishkav zachur
R' Yochanan: 'all the kings of the nations, all of them...' (Is 14:18) -- that they rested from mishkav zachur
R' Yochanan: all the days of that wicked man no laughter was found in the mouth of any creature
as it is said: 'the whole earth is at rest and quiet; they break forth into song' (Is 14:7) -- by implication, until now there was no song
R' Yochanan: it is forbidden to stand in that wicked man's house
as it is said: 'and satyrs shall dance there' (Is 13:21)
Rav: when that wicked man sought to do thus to that righteous man, his foreskin stretched three hundred cubits and went round the whole company
as it is said: '...drink also you, and be uncircumcised' (Hab 2:16) -- ערל in gematria is three hundred
Rav: when that wicked man went down to Gehinnom all who had gone down there trembled; they said: has he come to rule over them, or to be weak like them?
as it is said: 'have you also become weak as we? have you become like us [/ ruled over us]?' (Is 14:10)
a heavenly voice went out and said: 'whom do you surpass in beauty? go down and be laid with the uncircumcised' (Ezek 32:19)
Rav: 'how the oppressor has ceased, madheva has ceased' (Is 14:4) -- this nation that said 'measure and bring' has ceased
some say [Rav said]: [the nation] that said 'bring very, very much, without measure'
R' Yirmeya bar Abba: 'and surpassing greatness was added to me' (Dan 4:33) teaches that he rode on a male lion and tied a serpent to its head
to fulfil what is said: 'and the beasts of the field too I have given him to serve him' (Jer 27:6)
